utilitycraft:deepslate_aetherium_ore.description: Deepslate Aetherium Ore is a world-generated ore with an AT Core drop resolver and optional StatsCore mining modifiers.

modifiers.title: AT Core resolver
modifiers.copy: Replaces the normal raw-resource stack with the configured formula shown above. Silk Touch leaves the ore block intact.

modifiers.title: StatsCore · Bonus Loot
modifiers.copy: When the tool's resolved Bonus Loot chance succeeds, the ore gets an additional matching drop amount.

modifiers.title: StatsCore · Double / Triple Trouble
modifiers.copy: A refined compatible tool can roll a full extra loot-table result; Triple Trouble can add a second extra result.

utilitycraft:deepslate_titanium_ore.description: Deepslate Titanium Ore is a world-generated ore with an AT Core drop resolver and optional StatsCore mining modifiers.

modifiers.title: AT Core resolver
modifiers.copy: Replaces the normal raw-resource stack with the configured formula shown above. Silk Touch leaves the ore block intact.

modifiers.title: Smelting Pickaxe
modifiers.copy: Drops Titanium instead of Raw Titanium, using its own Fortuna multiplier; awards 2–5 XP.

modifiers.title: Hammer
modifiers.copy: Drops 5–12 Titanium Dust, plus 1–3 per Fortuna level.

modifiers.title: StatsCore · Forger / Crushing
modifiers.copy: Forger adds Titanium Plates equal to the tracked ore-drop amount; Crushing adds one Titanium Dust.

modifiers.title: StatsCore · Double / Triple Trouble
modifiers.copy: A refined compatible tool can roll a full extra loot-table result; Triple Trouble can add a second extra result.
